_doc: Equipment drops (spec #33, #109, #159, #292). items: the eligible equipment, ids only (reqLevel, reqJob and stats are read from the canonical Character.wz info in the asset cache): every v83 Character.wz cap, coat, longcoat, pants, shoes, glove, shield (109xxxx) and weapon of a playable family that is not cash, has reqLevel 0-70 and reqJob 0 (armour only) or the job line's bit, and that a regular v83 server gave out: dropped by an ordinary mob (id 100000-7999999) in Cosmic's drop_data or sold by a regular NPC shop (Cosmic shopitems, shop id below 9000000, not 1337). This keeps quest, event, GM and boss-only items out (tier B: server data used as facts). Weapons and shields carry their line's bit, never reqJob 0, so a Beginner and a Magician see none of the Warrior weapons or shields. Only items whose reqJob allows the character's job can drop, and a weapon only when it is of one of the job's weapon families (EquipmentDrops). The item ids live in the per-line fragments equipment_drops/<line>.json (common = reqJob 0 armour, then one file per job line; its weapons and shields with their line: wands and staves with the Magician, swords, axes, blunt weapons, spears, polearms and Warrior shields with the Warrior), concatenated and sorted ascending by DataRepo.load_all; a duplicate id is an error (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).
_rules: A drop does not follow the character's level (ADR 0006, #292): the stage's tier fixes a reqLevel band (stages.json drop_bands: tier 1 [0, 30], tier 2 [30, 60], tier C owner call) and an ordinary drop is any item in the band the job class wears and, for a weapon, whose family is one of the job's weapon_families (survivor/jobs/<line>.json), chosen uniformly (tier C). chance: per ordinary kill, sized once from an estimate (tier C): a full Henesys clear is about 3,300 kills and the ticket wants about 8-12 items a round including the boss drops, so about 7 ordinary drops is 0.002 per kill (v83 mobs gave equipment on 0.7-2% of kills, but a round has thousands of kills). boss_drops: items each scheduled boss death drops, no chance roll (tier C: spec #237 owner call, exactly two instead of a potion bundle). boss_top_parts: a boss item comes from the top 1/boss_top_parts of the band, reqLevel >= max - (max - min) / boss_top_parts (the highest reqLevel in the band when nothing is that high; the eligible item nearest to the band when it is empty), tier C owner call: a third.
